def load_cloud_transport(path: Path | None = None):
    path = Path(path or (PACKAGE_ROOT / "collector/cloud.py")).resolve()
    if not path.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError(f"packaged cloud transport is missing: {path}")
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("p1_postfix_cloud", path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"cannot load packaged cloud transport: {path}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def _write_json(path: Path, value: dict) -> None:
    path = Path(path)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp")
    with temporary.open("w") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write("\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def _create_dispatch_claim(document: dict) -> dict:
    lease = _controller_lease(document)
    claim = {
        "dispatch_id": document["dispatch_id"],
        "batch_manifest_sha256": document["batch_manifest_sha256"],
        "control_archive_sha256": document["control_archive_sha256"],
        "source_commit": document["source_commit"],
        "profile": "full",
        "state": "claimed_before_cloud_upload",
        "validation_gate_kind": document["validation_gate_kind"],
        "validation_gate_sha256": document["full_check_gate_sha256"],
        "admission_eligible": False,
        "maximum_product_invocations": 1,
        "retry_limit": 0,
        raise RuntimeError("not all completion diagnostic VMs are deallocated")
    return record


def _read_handle(document: dict) -> dict:
    handle = _load_json(HANDLE_PATH, "completion runtime handle")
    expected = {
        "dispatch_id": document["dispatch_id"],
        "unit": document["systemd_service"]["unit"],
        "remote_output_root": document["remote_output_root"],
        "source_commit": document["source_commit"],
        "binary_sha256": document["binary_sha256"],
        "batch_manifest_sha256": document["batch_manifest_sha256"],
        "control_archive_sha256": document["control_archive_sha256"],
        "controller_lease": _controller_lease(document),
    }
    for key, value in expected.items():
        if handle.get(key) != value:
            raise RuntimeError(f"completion runtime handle mismatch: {key}")
    return handle


def _status_from_response(response: str, document: dict) -> dict:
    begin, end = "COMPLETION_STATUS_JSON_BEGIN", "COMPLETION_STATUS_JSON_END"
    if response.count(begin) != 1 or response.count(end) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("completion observation has no unique status payload")
    payload = response.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0].strip()
    try:
        value = json.loads(payload)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise RuntimeError("completion observation status is not JSON") from error
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != "completion-observation-v1":
        raise RuntimeError("completion observation status has the wrong schema")
    lease = _controller_lease(document)
    expected = {
        "unit": lease["unit"],
        "dispatch_id": lease["dispatch_id"],
        "controller_owner_id": lease["owner_id"],
    }
    for key, wanted in expected.items():
        if value.get(key) != wanted:
            raise RuntimeError(f"completion observation ownership mismatch: {key}")
    return value


def _collect_results(cloud, env, result_blob: str, handle: dict) -> None:
    archive_path = PREP / "results.tar.gz"
    try:
        cloud.download(result_blob, archive_path, env)
        handle["state"] = "terminal_archive_downloaded"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        _extract_results(archive_path, PREP / "raw")
        handle["state"] = "terminal_artifacts_collected"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
    finally:
        _deallocate_all(cloud, env)


def _extract_results(archive_path: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
    if destination.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("completion result extraction directory already exists")
    with tarfile.open(archive_path, "r:gz") as archive:
        members = archive.getmembers()
        names = [member.name for member in members]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)):
            raise RuntimeError("completion result archive has duplicate members")
        for member in members:
            name = Path(member.name)
            if name.is_absolute() or ".." in name.parts or member.issym() or member.islnk():
                raise RuntimeError("completion result archive has unsafe members")
        archive.extractall(destination, filter="data")


def execute(cloud_module=None) -> dict:
    document = read_manifest()
    cloud = cloud_module or load_cloud_transport()
    _create_dispatch_claim(document)
    handle = {
        "schema": "completion-runtime-handle-v1",
        "dispatch_id": document["dispatch_id"],
        "unit": document["systemd_service"]["unit"],
        "remote_output_root": document["remote_output_root"],
        "source_commit": document["source_commit"],
        "binary_sha256": document["binary_sha256"],
        "batch_manifest_sha256": document["batch_manifest_sha256"],
        "control_archive_sha256": document["control_archive_sha256"],
        "state": "claimed",
        "product_deadline_seconds": None,
        "retry_permitted": False,
    }
    _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
    env = cloud.environment()
    all_vms = configured_vms()
    validation_vm = all_vms[0]
    states = cloud.states(env)
    if set(states) != set(all_vms) or any(value != "VM deallocated" for value in states.values()):
        raise RuntimeError("completion diagnostic requires all three VMs initially deallocated")
    remote_start_maybe = False
    try:
        cloud.start(validation_vm, env)
        handle["state"] = "vm_started"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        control_blob = document["dispatch_id"] + "-control.tar.gz"
        cloud.upload(prepared_member(document["control_archive"]), control_blob, env)
        handle["state"] = "start_call_issued"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        remote_start_maybe = True
        response = cloud.run(
            validation_vm,
            remote_start_script(document, cloud.url(control_blob, "r", env)),
        )
        (PREP / "start-transport.json").write_text(response + "\n")
        acknowledgement = "COMPLETION_DIAGNOSTIC_START_ACK:" + document["systemd_service"]["unit"]
        if acknowledgement not in response:
            handle["state"] = "start_unknown"
            _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
            raise RuntimeError("completion service start acknowledgement missing; observe exact handle and never replay")
        handle["state"] = "start_acknowledged"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        return handle
    except Exception:
        if not remote_start_maybe:
            _deallocate_all(cloud, env)
        raise


def observe(cloud_module=None) -> dict:
    document = read_manifest(require_unclaimed=False)
    if not CLAIM_PATH.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("completion dispatch claim is missing; observation cannot start work")
    handle = _read_handle(document)
    cloud = cloud_module or load_cloud_transport()
    env = cloud.environment()
    validation_vm = configured_vms()[0]
    result_blob = document["dispatch_id"] + "-results.tar.gz"
    response = cloud.run(
        validation_vm,
        remote_observe_script(document, cloud.url(result_blob, "cw", env)),
    )
    OBSERVATIONS_PATH.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    sequence = len(list(OBSERVATIONS_PATH.glob("observation-*.transport.json"))) + 1
    transport_path = OBSERVATIONS_PATH / f"observation-{sequence:04d}.transport.json"
    transport_path.write_text(response + "\n")
    status = _status_from_response(response)
    _write_json(OBSERVATIONS_PATH / f"observation-{sequence:04d}.json", status)
    lifecycle = status.get("lifecycle")
    if lifecycle == "running":
        handle["state"] = "running"
        handle["last_observation"] = sequence
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        return status
    if lifecycle != "terminal":
        handle["state"] = "unknown_never_replay"
        handle["last_observation"] = sequence
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        return status
    acknowledgement = "COMPLETION_DIAGNOSTIC_TERMINAL_UPLOAD_ACK:" + document["systemd_service"]["unit"]
    if acknowledgement not in response:
        handle["state"] = "terminal_collection_pending"
        handle["last_observation"] = sequence
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        raise RuntimeError("completion service is terminal but result upload is not acknowledged")
    archive_path = PREP / "results.tar.gz"
    try:
        cloud.download(result_blob, archive_path, env)
        _extract_results(archive_path, PREP / "raw")
    finally:
        _deallocate_all(cloud, env)
    handle["state"] = "terminal_collected"
    handle["last_observation"] = sequence
    handle["terminal_success"] = status.get("terminal_success") is True
    _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
    return status

def classify(properties):
    if properties.get("LoadState") in {"not-found", "unknown", None}:
        return "unknown"
    active, sub = properties.get("ActiveState"), properties.get("SubState")
    if active == "active" and sub == "exited":
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"failed", "inactive"} and properties.get("ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic") not in {"", "0", None}:
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"activating", "active", "deactivating"}:
        return "running"
    return "unknown"


def observe(remote_root, unit, run=subprocess.run, cgroup_root=Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")):
    if not UNIT_RE.fullmatch(unit):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic systemd unit")
    remote_root = Path(remote_root)
    properties = _properties(unit, run=run)
    lifecycle = classify(properties)
    claim = _read_json(remote_root / "claim-worker-1.json")
    if claim is None:
        claim = _read_json(Path("/opt/p1/batch-claims") / unit.removesuffix(".service") / "worker-1.json")
    record = {
        "schema": "completion-observation-v1",
        "unit": unit,
        "lifecycle": lifecycle,
        "properties": properties,
        "runtime_boundary": _read_json(remote_root / "runtime-boundary.json"),
        "worker_claim": claim,
        "process": _read_json(remote_root / "output/process.json"),
        "outcome": _read_json(remote_root / "output/outcome.json"),
        "profile_status": _read_json(remote_root / "output/relations-cpu.pprof.json"),
        "progress": _last_phase(remote_root / "output/process.log"),
        "collector_log_bytes": _last_phase(remote_root / "collector.log")["bytes"],
        "cgroup": _cgroup_events(cgroup_root, properties.get("ControlGroup")),
    }
    record["product_started"] = bool(claim and claim.get("started"))
    record["terminal_success"] = bool(
        lifecycle == "terminal"
        and properties.get("Result") == "success"
        and properties.get("ExecMainCode") == "exited"
        and properties.get("ExecMainStatus") == "0"
    )
    return record


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--remote-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--unit", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(observe(args.remote_root, args.unit), sort_keys=True))

def classify(properties):
    if properties.get("LoadState") in {"not-found", "unknown", None}:
        return "unknown"
    active, sub = properties.get("ActiveState"), properties.get("SubState")
    if active == "active" and sub == "exited":
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"failed", "inactive"} and properties.get("ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic") not in {"", "0", None}:
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"activating", "active", "deactivating"}:
        return "running"
    return "unknown"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read one durable completion-diagnostic service without changing it."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

SYSTEMCTL = "/usr/bin/systemctl"
UNIT_RE = re.compile(r"^p1-diag-[a-z0-9-]+\.service$")
IDENTIFIER_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,95}$")
PROPERTIES = (
    "LoadState", "ActiveState", "SubState", "Result", "ExecMainCode",
    "ExecMainStatus", "ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic",
    "ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic", "ControlGroup", "MemoryCurrent",
    "MemoryPeak", "MemoryMax", "TasksCurrent", "TasksMax", "CPUUsageNSec",
    "NRestarts", "RuntimeMaxUSec", "OOMPolicy", "KillMode",
    "PrivateNetwork", "RestrictAddressFamilies", "Restart", "RemainAfterExit",
)


def _properties(unit, run=subprocess.run):
    command = [SYSTEMCTL, "show", unit, "--no-pager"]
    command.extend(f"--property={name}" for name in PROPERTIES)
    result = run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl show failed"}
    values = {}
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        key, separator, value = line.partition("=")
        if not separator or key not in PROPERTIES or key in values:
            return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl output malformed"}
        values[key] = value
    if set(values) != set(PROPERTIES):
        return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl output incomplete"}
    return values


def _read_json(path):
    try:
        value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None


def _verify_controller_lease(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id):
    if not IDENTIFIER_RE.fullmatch(dispatch_id) or not IDENTIFIER_RE.fullmatch(owner_id):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic controller ownership identity")
    expected = {"owner_id": owner_id, "dispatch_id": dispatch_id, "unit": unit}
    observed = _read_json(Path(remote_root) / "controller-lease.json")
    if observed != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("completion diagnostic controller ownership lease mismatch")
    return observed


def _last_phase(path, max_bytes=256 * 1024):
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        size = path.stat().st_size
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            stream.seek(max(0, size - max_bytes))
            raw = stream.read(max_bytes)
    except OSError:
        return {"bytes": None, "last_event": None}
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
    for line in reversed(lines):
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get("event"), str):
            return {"bytes": size, "last_event": value}
    return {"bytes": size, "last_event": None}


def _cgroup_events(root, control_group):
    if not isinstance(control_group, str) or not control_group.startswith("/"):
        return {"status": "unavailable"}
    cgroup = Path(root) / control_group.lstrip("/")
    result = {"status": "available", "path": control_group}
    for name in ("memory.current", "memory.peak", "memory.max", "memory.events",
                 "pids.current", "pids.max", "pids.events"):
        try:
            result[name] = (cgroup / name).read_text().strip()
        except OSError:
            result[name] = None
    if all(result[name] is None for name in result if name not in {"status", "path"}):
        result["status"] = "unavailable"
    return result


def classify(properties):
    if properties.get("LoadState") in {"not-found", "unknown", None}:
        return "unknown"
    active, sub = properties.get("ActiveState"), properties.get("SubState")
    if active == "active" and sub == "exited":
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"failed", "inactive"} and properties.get("ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic") not in {"", "0", None}:
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"activating", "active", "deactivating"}:
        return "running"
    return "unknown"


def observe(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id, run=subprocess.run,
            cgroup_root=Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")):
    if not UNIT_RE.fullmatch(unit):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic systemd unit")
    remote_root = Path(remote_root)
    _verify_controller_lease(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id)
    properties = _properties(unit, run=run)
    lifecycle = classify(properties)
    claim = _read_json(remote_root / "claim-worker-1.json")
    if claim is None:
        claim = _read_json(Path("/opt/p1/batch-claims") / unit.removesuffix(".service") / "worker-1.json")
    record = {
        "schema": "completion-observation-v1",
        "unit": unit,
        "dispatch_id": dispatch_id,
        "controller_owner_id": owner_id,
        "lifecycle": lifecycle,
        "properties": properties,
        "runtime_boundary": _read_json(remote_root / "runtime-boundary.json"),
        "worker_claim": claim,
        "process": _read_json(remote_root / "output/process.json"),
        "outcome": _read_json(remote_root / "output/outcome.json"),
        "profile_status": _read_json(remote_root / "output/relations-cpu.pprof.json"),
        "progress": _last_phase(remote_root / "output/process.log"),
        "collector_log_bytes": _last_phase(remote_root / "collector.log")["bytes"],
        "cgroup": _cgroup_events(cgroup_root, properties.get("ControlGroup")),
    }
    record["product_started"] = bool(claim and claim.get("started"))
    record["terminal_success"] = bool(
        lifecycle == "terminal"
        and properties.get("Result") == "success"
        and properties.get("ExecMainCode") == "exited"
        and properties.get("ExecMainStatus") == "0"
    )
    return record


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--remote-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--unit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--dispatch-id", required=True)

from pathlib import Path
import re

UNIT_RE = re.compile(r"^p1-diag-[a-z0-9-]+\.service$")
IDENTIFIER_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,95}$")

    "LoadState", "ActiveState", "SubState", "Result", "ExecMainCode",
    "ExecMainStatus", "ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic",
    "ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic", "ControlGroup", "MemoryCurrent",
    "MemoryPeak", "MemoryMax", "TasksCurrent", "TasksMax", "CPUUsageNSec",
    "NRestarts", "RuntimeMaxUSec", "OOMPolicy", "KillMode",
    "PrivateNetwork", "RestrictAddressFamilies", "Restart", "RemainAfterExit",
)


def _properties(unit, run=subprocess.run):
    command = [SYSTEMCTL, "show", unit, "--no-pager"]
    command.extend(f"--property={name}" for name in PROPERTIES)
    result = run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl show failed"}
    values = {}
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        key, separator, value = line.partition("=")
        if not separator or key not in PROPERTIES or key in values:
            return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl output malformed"}
        values[key] = value
    if set(values) != set(PROPERTIES):
        return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl output incomplete"}
    return values


def _read_json(path):
    try:
        value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None


def _verify_controller_lease(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id):
    if not IDENTIFIER_RE.fullmatch(dispatch_id) or not IDENTIFIER_RE.fullmatch(owner_id):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic controller ownership identity")
    expected = {"owner_id": owner_id, "dispatch_id": dispatch_id, "unit": unit}
    observed = _read_json(Path(remote_root) / "controller-lease.json")
    if observed != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("completion diagnostic controller ownership lease mismatch")
    return observed


def _last_phase(path, max_bytes=256 * 1024):
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        size = path.stat().st_size
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            stream.seek(max(0, size - max_bytes))
            raw = stream.read(max_bytes)
    except OSError:
        return {"bytes": None, "last_event": None}
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
    for line in reversed(lines):
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get("event"), str):
            return {"bytes": size, "last_event": value}
    return {"bytes": size, "last_event": None}

    if not isinstance(control_group, str) or not control_group.startswith("/"):
        return {"status": "unavailable"}
    cgroup = Path(root) / control_group.lstrip("/")
    result = {"status": "available", "path": control_group}
    for name in ("memory.current", "memory.peak", "memory.max", "memory.events",
                 "pids.current", "pids.max", "pids.events"):
        try:
            result[name] = (cgroup / name).read_text().strip()
        except OSError:
            result[name] = None

        result["status"] = "unavailable"
    return result


def classify(properties):
    if properties.get("LoadState") in {"not-found", "unknown", None}:
        return "unknown"
    active, sub = properties.get("ActiveState"), properties.get("SubState")
    if active == "active" and sub == "exited":
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"failed", "inactive"} and properties.get("ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic") not in {"", "0", None}:
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"activating", "active", "deactivating"}:
        return "running"
    return "unknown"


def observe(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id, run=subprocess.run,
            cgroup_root=Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")):
    if not UNIT_RE.fullmatch(unit):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic systemd unit")
    remote_root = Path(remote_root)
    _verify_controller_lease(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id)
    properties = _properties(unit, run=run)
    lifecycle = classify(properties)
    claim = _read_json(remote_root / "claim-worker-1.json")
    if claim is None:
        claim = _read_json(Path("/opt/p1/batch-claims") / unit.removesuffix(".service") / "worker-1.json")
    record = {
        "schema": "completion-observation-v1",
        "unit": unit,
        "dispatch_id": dispatch_id,
        "controller_owner_id": owner_id,
        "lifecycle": lifecycle,
        "properties": properties,
        "runtime_boundary": _read_json(remote_root / "runtime-boundary.json"),
        "worker_claim": claim,
        "process": _read_json(remote_root / "output/process.json"),
        "outcome": _read_json(remote_root / "output/outcome.json"),
        "profile_status": _read_json(remote_root / "output/relations-cpu.pprof.json"),
        "progress": _last_phase(remote_root / "output/process.log"),
        "collector_log_bytes": _last_phase(remote_root / "collector.log")["bytes"],
        "cgroup": _cgroup_events(cgroup_root, properties.get("ControlGroup")),
    }
    record["product_started"] = bool(claim and claim.get("started"))
    record["terminal_success"] = bool(
        lifecycle == "terminal"
        and properties.get("Result") == "success"
        and properties.get("ExecMainCode") == "exited"
        and properties.get("ExecMainStatus") == "0"
    )
    return record


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--remote-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--unit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--dispatch-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--owner-id", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(observe(args.remote_root, args.unit, args.dispatch_id, args.owner_id), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read one durable completion-diagnostic service without changing it."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

SYSTEMCTL = "/usr/bin/systemctl"
UNIT_RE = re.compile(r"^p1-diag-[a-z0-9-]+\.service$")
IDENTIFIER_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,95}$")
PROPERTIES = (
    "LoadState", "ActiveState", "SubState", "Result", "ExecMainCode",
    "ExecMainStatus", "ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic",
    "ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic", "ControlGroup", "MemoryCurrent",
    "MemoryPeak", "MemoryMax", "TasksCurrent", "TasksMax", "CPUUsageNSec",
    "NRestarts", "RuntimeMaxUSec", "OOMPolicy", "KillMode",
    "PrivateNetwork", "RestrictAddressFamilies", "Restart", "RemainAfterExit",
)


def _properties(unit, run=subprocess.run):
    command = [SYSTEMCTL, "show", unit, "--no-pager"]
    command.extend(f"--property={name}" for name in PROPERTIES)
    result = run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl show failed"}
    values = {}
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        key, separator, value = line.partition("=")
        if not separator or key not in PROPERTIES or key in values:
            return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl output malformed"}
        values[key] = value
    if set(values) != set(PROPERTIES):
        return {"LoadState": "unknown", "error": "systemctl output incomplete"}
    return values


def _read_json(path):
    try:
        value = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None
    return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None


def _verify_controller_lease(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id):
    if not IDENTIFIER_RE.fullmatch(dispatch_id) or not IDENTIFIER_RE.fullmatch(owner_id):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic controller ownership identity")
    expected = {"owner_id": owner_id, "dispatch_id": dispatch_id, "unit": unit}
    observed = _read_json(Path(remote_root) / "controller-lease.json")
    if observed != expected:
        raise RuntimeError("completion diagnostic controller ownership lease mismatch")
    return observed


def _last_phase(path, max_bytes=256 * 1024):
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        size = path.stat().st_size
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            stream.seek(max(0, size - max_bytes))
            raw = stream.read(max_bytes)
    except OSError:
        return {"bytes": None, "last_event": None}
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
    for line in reversed(lines):
        try:
            value = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(value.get("event"), str):
            return {"bytes": size, "last_event": value}
    return {"bytes": size, "last_event": None}


def _cgroup_events(root, control_group):
    if not isinstance(control_group, str) or not control_group.startswith("/"):
        return {"status": "unavailable"}
    cgroup = Path(root) / control_group.lstrip("/")
    result = {"status": "available", "path": control_group}
    for name in ("memory.current", "memory.peak", "memory.max", "memory.events",
                 "pids.current", "pids.max", "pids.events"):
        try:
            result[name] = (cgroup / name).read_text().strip()
        except OSError:
            result[name] = None
    if all(result[name] is None for name in result if name not in {"status", "path"}):
        result["status"] = "unavailable"
    return result


def classify(properties):
    if properties.get("LoadState") in {"not-found", "unknown", None}:
        return "unknown"
    active, sub = properties.get("ActiveState"), properties.get("SubState")
    if active == "active" and sub == "exited":
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"failed", "inactive"} and properties.get("ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic") not in {"", "0", None}:
        return "terminal"
    if active in {"activating", "active", "deactivating"}:
        return "running"
    return "unknown"


def observe(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id, run=subprocess.run,
            cgroup_root=Path("/sys/fs/cgroup")):
    if not UNIT_RE.fullmatch(unit):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid completion diagnostic systemd unit")
    remote_root = Path(remote_root)
    _verify_controller_lease(remote_root, unit, dispatch_id, owner_id)
    properties = _properties(unit, run=run)
    lifecycle = classify(properties)
    claim = _read_json(remote_root / "claim-worker-1.json")
    if claim is None:
        claim = _read_json(Path("/opt/p1/batch-claims") / unit.removesuffix(".service") / "worker-1.json")
    record = {
        "schema": "completion-observation-v1",
        "unit": unit,
        "dispatch_id": dispatch_id,
        "controller_owner_id": owner_id,
        "lifecycle": lifecycle,
        "properties": properties,
        "runtime_boundary": _read_json(remote_root / "runtime-boundary.json"),
        "worker_claim": claim,
        "process": _read_json(remote_root / "output/process.json"),
        "outcome": _read_json(remote_root / "output/outcome.json"),
        "profile_status": _read_json(remote_root / "output/relations-cpu.pprof.json"),
        "progress": _last_phase(remote_root / "output/process.log"),
        "collector_log_bytes": _last_phase(remote_root / "collector.log")["bytes"],
        "cgroup": _cgroup_events(cgroup_root, properties.get("ControlGroup")),
    }
    record["product_started"] = bool(claim and claim.get("started"))
    record["terminal_success"] = bool(
        lifecycle == "terminal"
        and properties.get("Result") == "success"
        and properties.get("ExecMainCode") == "exited"
        and properties.get("ExecMainStatus") == "0"
    )
    return record


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--remote-root", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--unit", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--dispatch-id", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--owner-id", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(observe(args.remote_root, args.unit, args.dispatch_id, args.owner_id), sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a bounded completion package from explicit local inputs.

This helper is deliberately offline.  It validates every source/build/input
binding before writing a new package, and defaults to a no-write dry run.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
from typing import Any


PACKAGE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TEMPLATE_ROOT = PACKAGE_ROOT
HASH_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
COMMIT_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-f]{40}$")
ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,95}$")
CAP = 100
CONTROL_MEMBERS = (
    "collector/run_remote.py",
    "collector/batch_budget.py",
    "collector/campaign_gate.py",
    "collector/cloud.py",
    "collector/observe_remote.py",
    "corpus/p1_scenario.py",
    "corpus/corpus-manifest.json",
    "build-manifest.json",
    "batch-manifest.json",
    "full-check-gate.json",
    "control-hashes.txt",
)
TEMPLATE_MEMBERS = (
    "controller/controller.py",
    "collector/run_remote.py",
    "collector/batch_budget.py",
    "collector/campaign_gate.py",
    "collector/cloud.py",
    "collector/observe_remote.py",
    "corpus/p1_scenario.py",
)
EXPECTED_RUNNER_PINS = (
    "EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT",
    "EXPECTED_BINARY_SHA256",
    "EXPECTED_REPOSITORY",
    "EXPECTED_INPUT_MANIFEST_SHA256",
)


class PreparationError(ValueError):
    """The requested package cannot be frozen from the supplied inputs."""


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    path = _regular_file(path, "file")
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def _regular_file(value: Path, label: str) -> Path:
    value = Path(value)
    try:
        info = value.lstat()
    except OSError as error:
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} is unavailable: {value}") from error
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} must be a regular file: {value}")
    return value


def _directory(value: Path, label: str) -> Path:
    value = Path(value)
    try:
        info = value.lstat()
    except OSError as error:
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} is unavailable: {value}") from error
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode):
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} must be a real directory: {value}")
    return value


def _json(path: Path, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(_regular_file(path, label).read_text())
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as error:
        raise PreparationError(f"cannot read {label}: {path}") from error
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} must be a JSON object: {path}")
    return value


def _hash_field(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not HASH_RE.fullmatch(value):
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} must be a SHA-256")
    return value


def _require_hash(path: Path, expected: str, label: str) -> str:
    actual = sha256(path)
    if actual != expected:
        raise PreparationError(f"{label} hash mismatch")
    return actual


def _tracked_entries(path: Path) -> dict[str, tuple[str, int]]:
    """Parse the canonical ``mode<TAB>sha<TAB>path`` source manifest."""
    entries: dict[str, tuple[str, int]] = {}
    try:
        lines = path.read_text().splitlines()
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
        raise PreparationError(f"tracked manifest is unreadable: {path}") from error
    for line in lines:
        match = re.fullmatch(r"(100644|100755)\t([0-9a-f]{64})\t(.+)", line)
        if match is None:
            raise PreparationError("tracked manifest has an invalid row")
        mode, digest, name = match.groups()
        relative = Path(name)
        if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts or name in entries:
            raise PreparationError("tracked manifest has an unsafe or duplicate path")
        entries[name] = (digest, int(mode[-3:], 8))
    if not entries:
        raise PreparationError("tracked manifest is empty")
    return entries


def _source_entries(root: Path) -> dict[str, tuple[str, int]]:
    entries: dict[str, tuple[str, int]] = {}
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        relative = path.relative_to(root)
        if relative.parts and relative.parts[0] == ".git":
            continue
        try:
            info = path.lstat()
        except OSError as error:
            raise PreparationError(f"source path cannot be inspected: {path}") from error
        if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
            raise PreparationError(f"source tree contains a symlink: {relative}")
        if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
            continue
        mode = stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)
        if mode not in (0o644, 0o755):
            raise PreparationError(f"source file has unsupported mode: {relative}")
        entries[relative.as_posix()] = (sha256(path), mode)
    return entries


def _validate_source_tree(root: Path, manifest: Path, expected_count: int) -> None:
    listed = _tracked_entries(manifest)
    if len(listed) != expected_count:
        raise PreparationError("tracked manifest count does not match build manifest")
    actual = _source_entries(root)
    if actual != listed:
        missing = sorted(set(listed) - set(actual))
        extra = sorted(set(actual) - set(listed))
        changed = sorted(name for name in set(actual) & set(listed) if actual[name] != listed[name])
        detail = ", ".join((f"missing={missing[:1]}" if missing else "",
                             f"extra={extra[:1]}" if extra else "",
                             f"changed={changed[:1]}" if changed else "")).strip(", ")
        raise PreparationError(f"source tree does not match tracked manifest{': ' + detail if detail else ''}")


def _load_budget():
    path = TEMPLATE_ROOT / "collector" / "batch_budget.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("prepare_batch_budget", path)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise PreparationError("cannot load batch budget controls")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def _runner_pins(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(_regular_file(path, "runner").read_text())
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, SyntaxError) as error:
        raise PreparationError(f"runner is not valid Python: {path}") from error
    pins: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign) or len(node.targets) != 1:
            continue
        target = node.targets[0]
        if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in EXPECTED_RUNNER_PINS:
            try:
                pins[target.id] = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
            except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
                raise PreparationError(f"runner pin is not a literal: {target.id}") from error
    missing = [name for name in EXPECTED_RUNNER_PINS if name not in pins]
    if missing:
        raise PreparationError("runner pins missing: " + ", ".join(missing))
    return pins


def _validate_inputs(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source_root = _directory(args.source_root, "source root")
    source_archive = _regular_file(args.source_archive, "source archive")
    tracked_manifest = _regular_file(args.tracked_manifest, "tracked manifest")
    binary = _regular_file(args.binary, "evaluator binary")
    build_path = _regular_file(args.build_manifest, "build manifest")
    corpus_path = _regular_file(args.corpus_manifest, "corpus manifest")
    gate_path = _regular_file(args.full_check_gate, "full-check gate")
    runner = _regular_file(args.runner, "runner")
    source_commit = args.source_commit.lower()
    source_digest = args.source_digest.lower()
    if not COMMIT_RE.fullmatch(source_commit):
        raise PreparationError("source commit must be a 40-character lowercase Git identity")
    _hash_field(source_digest, "source digest")
    if not ID_RE.fullmatch(args.dispatch_id):
        raise PreparationError("dispatch ID must be a path-safe lowercase identifier")
    if not args.owner_id or any(char.isspace() for char in args.owner_id):
        raise PreparationError("owner ID must be a non-empty token without whitespace")
    build = _json(build_path, "build manifest")
    corpus = _json(corpus_path, "corpus manifest")
    gate = _json(gate_path, "full-check gate")
    binary_digest = sha256(binary)
    if build.get("source_commit") != source_commit or build.get("binary_sha256") != binary_digest:
        raise PreparationError("build manifest is not bound to source commit and binary")
    if type(build.get("exit_code")) is not int or build["exit_code"] != 0:
        raise PreparationError("build manifest does not record a successful build")
    source_archive_digest = sha256(source_archive)
    tracked_manifest_digest = sha256(tracked_manifest)
    if build.get("source_archive_sha256") != source_archive_digest:
        raise PreparationError("source archive hash does not match build manifest")
    if build.get("tracked_manifest_sha256") != tracked_manifest_digest:
        raise PreparationError("tracked manifest hash does not match build manifest")
    if type(build.get("tracked_file_count")) is not int or build["tracked_file_count"] <= 0:
        raise PreparationError("build manifest has no positive tracked file count")
    _validate_source_tree(source_root, tracked_manifest, build["tracked_file_count"])
    if "source_digest" in build and build["source_digest"] != source_digest:
        raise PreparationError("source digest does not match build manifest")
    if corpus.get("manifest") != "p1-corpus-v1" or not isinstance(corpus.get("repositories"), list):
        raise PreparationError("unsupported corpus manifest")
    repositories = {item.get("id"): item for item in corpus["repositories"] if isinstance(item, dict)}
    repository = repositories.get(args.repository)
    if repository is None or not COMMIT_RE.fullmatch(str(repository.get("commit", ""))):
        raise PreparationError("selected repository is absent or has no frozen commit")
    repository_commit = repository["commit"]
    input_manifest_digest = sha256(corpus_path)
    if gate.get("schema") != "full-check-canonical-v1" or gate.get("status") != "passed":
        raise PreparationError("full-check gate is not a passed canonical gate")
    if gate.get("admission_eligible") is not False or gate.get("required_for_execution") is not True:
        raise PreparationError("full-check gate execution boundary changed")
    if gate.get("evaluator_source_commit") != source_commit or gate.get("evaluator_binary_sha256") != binary_digest:
        raise PreparationError("full-check gate is not bound to source and binary")
    if gate.get("evaluator_build_manifest_sha256") != sha256(build_path):
        raise PreparationError("full-check gate is not bound to build manifest")
    if gate.get("source_archive_sha256") != source_archive_digest or gate.get("tracked_manifest_sha256") != tracked_manifest_digest:
        raise PreparationError("full-check gate source capture binding changed")
    pins = _runner_pins(runner)
    expected_pins = {
        "EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT": source_commit,
        "EXPECTED_BINARY_SHA256": binary_digest,
        "EXPECTED_REPOSITORY": args.repository,
        "EXPECTED_INPUT_MANIFEST_SHA256": input_manifest_digest,
    }
    for name, expected in expected_pins.items():
        if pins[name] != expected:
            raise PreparationError(f"runner pin mismatch: {name}")
    if args.unit != args.dispatch_id + ".service":
        raise PreparationError("unit must be dispatch ID plus .service")
    for label, value in (("remote source root", args.remote_source_root),
                         ("remote output root", args.remote_output_root),
                         ("remote claim path", args.remote_claim_path)):
        if not value.startswith("/") or ".." in Path(value).parts:
            raise PreparationError(f"{label} must be an absolute path without ..")
    if args.dispatch_id not in args.remote_output_root or args.dispatch_id not in args.remote_claim_path:
        raise PreparationError("remote paths must contain the dispatch ID")
    budget = _load_budget()
    cell = {
        "worker": 1,
        "repository": args.repository,
        "profile": "full",
        "verb": "snapshot",
        "scenario": "diagnostic",
        "trial": 0,
        "arms": [False],
        "preparatory_invocations": 0,
    }
    cell["cell_id"] = budget.cell_id(cell)
    batch = {
        "version": 1,
        "cap": CAP,
        "batch_id": args.dispatch_id,
        "scope": "bounded-diagnostic",
        "identity": {
            "binary_sha256": binary_digest,
            "input_manifest_sha256": input_manifest_digest,
            "runner_sha256": sha256(runner),
            "scenario_sha256": sha256(TEMPLATE_ROOT / "corpus" / "p1_scenario.py"),
            "gate_sha256": sha256(TEMPLATE_ROOT / "collector" / "campaign_gate.py"),
            "budget_sha256": sha256(TEMPLATE_ROOT / "collector" / "batch_budget.py"),
            "build_manifest_sha256": sha256(build_path),
        },
        "cells": [cell],
        "workers": {"1": 1},
    }
    batch = budget.validate(batch, batch["identity"])
    return {
        "source_root": source_root,
        "source_archive": source_archive,
        "tracked_manifest": tracked_manifest,
        "binary": binary,
        "build_path": build_path,
        "corpus_path": corpus_path,
        "gate_path": gate_path,
        "runner": runner,
        "build": build,
        "corpus": corpus,
        "gate": gate,
        "binary_digest": binary_digest,
        "source_archive_digest": source_archive_digest,
        "tracked_manifest_digest": tracked_manifest_digest,
        "input_manifest_digest": input_manifest_digest,
        "batch": batch,
        "cell_id": cell["cell_id"],
        "repository_commit": repository_commit,
    }


def _manifest(args: argparse.Namespace, values: dict[str, Any], build_digest: str,
              batch_digest: str, gate_digest: str, archive_digest: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    template = _json(TEMPLATE_ROOT / "controller" / "manifest.json", "manifest template")
    result = copy.deepcopy(template)
    result.update({
        "status": "prepared only; no VM, cloud, collector, product, corpus, or benchmark execution",
        "dispatch_id": args.dispatch_id,
        "source_commit": args.source_commit.lower(),
        "source_digest": args.source_digest.lower(),
        "source_archive_sha256": values["source_archive_digest"],
        "tracked_manifest_sha256": values["tracked_manifest_digest"],
        "binary_sha256": values["binary_digest"],
        "input_manifest_sha256": values["input_manifest_digest"],
        "build_manifest_sha256": build_digest,
        "batch_manifest_sha256": batch_digest,
        "full_check_gate_sha256": gate_digest,
        "control_archive_sha256": archive_digest,
        "cell_id": values["cell_id"],
        "repository": args.repository,
        "frozen_repository_commit": values["repository_commit"],
        "remote_source_root": args.remote_source_root,
        "remote_output_root": args.remote_output_root,
        "remote_claim_path": args.remote_claim_path,
        "product_deadline_seconds": None,
        "product_timeout_mode": "none-user-authorized-completion",
        "batch_manifest": "batch-manifest.json",
        "build_manifest": "build-manifest.json",
        "control_archive": "control-files.tar.gz",
        "full_check_gate": "full-check-gate.json",
        "controller_lease": {"owner_id": args.owner_id, "dispatch_id": args.dispatch_id, "unit": args.unit},
    })
    result["systemd_service"] = dict(result.get("systemd_service", {}), unit=args.unit)
    result["full_check"] = {
        "source_commit": values["gate"].get("evaluator_source_commit"),
        "evidence_commit": values["gate"].get("full_check_evidence_commit"),
        "status": values["gate"].get("status"),
        "statusline_failed": values["gate"].get("claims", {}).get("correctness") is False,
        "full_coverage_claimed": values["gate"].get("disclosed_limitations", {}).get("full_coverage_claimed"),
    }
    return result


def _write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def _archive(root: Path, destination: Path) -> str:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode="w", format=tarfile.GNU_FORMAT) as archive:
        for name in CONTROL_MEMBERS:
            path = root / name
            info = archive.gettarinfo(str(path), arcname=name)
            info.uid = info.gid = 0
            info.uname = info.gname = ""
            info.mtime = 0
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                archive.addfile(info, stream)
    import gzip
    with destination.open("wb") as stream:
        with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode="wb", mtime=0) as compressed:
            compressed.write(buffer.getvalue())
    return sha256(destination)


def prepare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    values = _validate_inputs(args)
    summary = {
        "status": "validated; no files written" if args.dry_run else "prepared",
        "dispatch_id": args.dispatch_id,
        "owner_id": args.owner_id,
        "source_commit": args.source_commit.lower(),
        "binary_sha256": values["binary_digest"],
        "input_manifest_sha256": values["input_manifest_digest"],
        "derived_invocations": values["batch"]["derived_invocations"],
        "output": str(args.output),
    }
    if args.dry_run:
        return summary
    output = Path(args.output)
    if output.exists():
        raise PreparationError(f"refusing to overwrite existing output: {output}")
    if not output.parent.is_dir():
        raise PreparationError(f"output parent must already exist: {output.parent}")
    temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output.name}.", dir=output.parent))
    try:
        for name in TEMPLATE_MEMBERS:
            destination = temporary / name
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = values["runner"] if name == "collector/run_remote.py" else TEMPLATE_ROOT / name
            shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        shutil.copyfile(values["corpus_path"], temporary / "corpus/corpus-manifest.json")
        shutil.copyfile(values["build_path"], temporary / "build-manifest.json")
        shutil.copyfile(values["gate_path"], temporary / "full-check-gate.json")
        batch_path = temporary / "batch-manifest.json"
        _write_json(batch_path, values["batch"])
        hashes = "".join(f"{sha256(temporary / name)}  {name}\n" for name in CONTROL_MEMBERS if name != "control-hashes.txt")
        (temporary / "control-hashes.txt").write_text(hashes)

def _archive(root: Path, destination: Path) -> str:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode="w", format=tarfile.GNU_FORMAT) as archive:
        for name in CONTROL_MEMBERS:
            path = root / name
            info = archive.gettarinfo(str(path), arcname=name)
            info.uid = info.gid = 0
            info.uname = info.gname = ""
            info.mtime = 0
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                archive.addfile(info, stream)

    with destination.open("wb") as stream:
        with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode="wb", mtime=0) as compressed:
            compressed.write(buffer.getvalue())
    return sha256(destination)


def prepare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    values = _validate_inputs(args)
    summary = {
        "status": "validated; no files written" if args.dry_run else "prepared",
        "dispatch_id": args.dispatch_id,
        "owner_id": args.owner_id,
        "source_commit": args.source_commit.lower(),
        "binary_sha256": values["binary_digest"],
        "input_manifest_sha256": values["input_manifest_digest"],
        "derived_invocations": values["batch"]["derived_invocations"],
        "output": str(args.output),
    }
    if args.dry_run:
        return summary
    output = Path(args.output)
    if output.exists():
        raise PreparationError(f"refusing to overwrite existing output: {output}")
    if not output.parent.is_dir():
        raise PreparationError(f"output parent must already exist: {output.parent}")
    temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output.name}.", dir=output.parent))
    try:

            destination = temporary / name
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = values["runner"] if name == "collector/run_remote.py" else TEMPLATE_ROOT / name

        shutil.copyfile(values["corpus_path"], temporary / "corpus/corpus-manifest.json")
        shutil.copyfile(values["build_path"], temporary / "build-manifest.json")
        shutil.copyfile(values["gate_path"], temporary / "full-check-gate.json")
        batch_path = temporary / "batch-manifest.json"
        _write_json(batch_path, values["batch"])
        hashes = "".join(f"{sha256(temporary / name)}  {name}\n" for name in CONTROL_MEMBERS if name != "control-hashes.txt")
        (temporary / "control-hashes.txt").write_text(hashes)

        "source_commit": args.source_commit.lower(),
        "source_digest": args.source_digest.lower(),
        "source_archive_sha256": values["source_archive_digest"],
        "tracked_manifest_sha256": values["tracked_manifest_digest"],
        "binary_sha256": values["binary_digest"],
        "input_manifest_sha256": values["input_manifest_digest"],
        "build_manifest_sha256": build_digest,
        "batch_manifest_sha256": batch_digest,
        "full_check_gate_sha256": gate_digest,
        "control_archive_sha256": archive_digest,
        "cell_id": values["cell_id"],
        "repository": args.repository,
        "frozen_repository_commit": values["repository_commit"],
        "remote_source_root": args.remote_source_root,
        "remote_output_root": args.remote_output_root,
        "remote_claim_path": args.remote_claim_path,
        "product_deadline_seconds": None,
        "product_timeout_mode": "none-user-authorized-completion",
        "batch_manifest": "batch-manifest.json",
        "build_manifest": "build-manifest.json",
        "control_archive": "control-files.tar.gz",
        "full_check_gate": "full-check-gate.json",
        "controller_lease": {"owner_id": args.owner_id, "dispatch_id": args.dispatch_id, "unit": args.unit},
    })
    result["systemd_service"] = dict(result.get("systemd_service", {}), unit=args.unit)
    result["full_check"] = {
        "source_commit": values["gate"].get("evaluator_source_commit"),
        "evidence_commit": values["gate"].get("full_check_evidence_commit"),
        "status": values["gate"].get("status"),
        "statusline_failed": values["gate"].get("claims", {}).get("correctness") is False,
        "full_coverage_claimed": values["gate"].get("disclosed_limitations", {}).get("full_coverage_claimed"),
    }
    return result


def _write_json(path: Path, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def _archive(root: Path, destination: Path) -> str:
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buffer, mode="w", format=tarfile.GNU_FORMAT) as archive:
        for name in CONTROL_MEMBERS:
            path = root / name
            info = archive.gettarinfo(str(path), arcname=name)
            info.uid = info.gid = 0
            info.uname = info.gname = ""
            info.mtime = 0
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                archive.addfile(info, stream)
    import gzip
    with destination.open("wb") as stream:
        with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode="wb", mtime=0) as compressed:
            compressed.write(buffer.getvalue())
    return sha256(destination)


def prepare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
    values = _validate_inputs(args)
    summary = {
        "status": "validated; no files written" if args.dry_run else "prepared",
        "dispatch_id": args.dispatch_id,
        "owner_id": args.owner_id,
        "source_commit": args.source_commit.lower(),
        "binary_sha256": values["binary_digest"],
        "input_manifest_sha256": values["input_manifest_digest"],
        "derived_invocations": values["batch"]["derived_invocations"],
        "output": str(args.output),
    }
    if args.dry_run:
        return summary
    output = Path(args.output)
    if output.exists():
        raise PreparationError(f"refusing to overwrite existing output: {output}")
    if not output.parent.is_dir():
        raise PreparationError(f"output parent must already exist: {output.parent}")
    temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f".{output.name}.", dir=output.parent))
    try:
        for name in TEMPLATE_MEMBERS:
            destination = temporary / name
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            source = values["runner"] if name == "collector/run_remote.py" else TEMPLATE_ROOT / name
            shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
        shutil.copyfile(values["corpus_path"], temporary / "corpus/corpus-manifest.json")
        shutil.copyfile(values["build_path"], temporary / "build-manifest.json")
        shutil.copyfile(values["gate_path"], temporary / "full-check-gate.json")
        batch_path = temporary / "batch-manifest.json"
        _write_json(batch_path, values["batch"])
        hashes = "".join(f"{sha256(temporary / name)}  {name}\n" for name in CONTROL_MEMBERS if name != "control-hashes.txt")
        (temporary / "control-hashes.txt").write_text(hashes)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Collect one resource-bounded completion diagnostic request.

This package is preparation-only until all immutable pins are populated. It
retains the one-request controls and records diagnostic CPU-profile status
without imposing an elapsed product deadline or making a performance or
admission claim.
"""

import argparse

CONTROL_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

import batch_budget


EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT = "effa358f2ceaca2b9accd829984272598fa78078"

PROC_INIT_NETNS = Path("/proc/1/ns/net")

PHASE_BREADCRUMBS_ENV = "ENTIRE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION_CORPUS_PHASE_BREADCRUMBS"

RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_START_AFTER_ENV = "ENTIRE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION_CORPUS_RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_START_AFTER_NS"
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_NAME = "relations-cpu.pprof"
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_STATUS_NAME = "relations-cpu.pprof.json"
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_MAX_BYTES = 8 << 20
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_WINDOW_NS = 20_000_000_000
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_LATEST_START_NS = 90_000_000_000
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_REQUESTED_START_AFTER_NS = 88_000_000_000
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_STATUS_MAX_BYTES = 64 << 10
RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_STATUSES = frozenset({
    "scheduled", "starting", "active", "complete", "incomplete",
    "missed_safe_window", "cancelled", "error",
})


def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")


def _regular_file_size(path, label, max_bytes=None):
    """Inspect without following symlinks and enforce an optional byte bound."""
    path = Path(path)
    try:
        info = path.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None
    except OSError as error:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} cannot be inspected: {error}") from error
    if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} symlink is not allowed")
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError(f"{label} is not a regular file")
    claim_path = Path(claim_root) / batch["batch_id"] / f"worker-{worker}.json"
    return batch, cell, ledger, claim_path, identity


def run_request(output, binary, scenario_script, corpus_root, binary_sha256, source_root,
                build_manifest, batch_manifest, batch_worker, fingerprint_fn=fingerprint,
                process_factory=subprocess.Popen, _claim_root=FIXED_CLAIM_ROOT,
                runtime_boundary=None):
    output = Path(output).resolve()
    if not isinstance(runtime_boundary, dict) or runtime_boundary.get("status") != "passed":
        raise RuntimeError("verified completion runtime boundary is required before budget claim")
    if Path(corpus_root).resolve() != Path(EXPECTED_REPO_PATH).parent:
        raise RuntimeError("fingerprint corpus root differs from fixed product repository")
    if output.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("output directory already exists; refusing overwrite")
    binary, scenario_script, source_root = map(lambda p: Path(p).resolve(), (binary, scenario_script, source_root))
    if not binary.is_file() or not scenario_script.is_file() or not source_root.is_dir() or not binary.is_relative_to(source_root):
        raise RuntimeError("source, binary, or scenario input unavailable")
    if sha256(binary) != binary_sha256:
        raise RuntimeError("binary identity mismatch")
    scenario_sha256 = sha256(scenario_script)
    batch, cell, ledger, claim_path, budget_identity = claim_diagnostic_budget(
        batch_manifest, build_manifest, scenario_script, binary_sha256, batch_worker, _claim_root)
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    save(output / "runtime-boundary.json", runtime_boundary)
    manifest = expected_manifest(output, binary_sha256)
    manifest_path = output / "manifest.json"
    manifest["_path"] = str(manifest_path)
    save(manifest_path, {key: value for key, value in manifest.items() if key != "_path"})
    save(output / "identity.json", {"source_commit": EXPECTED_SOURCE_COMMIT, "source_root": str(source_root),
        "binary": str(binary), "binary_sha256": binary_sha256, "scenario_script": str(scenario_script),
        "scenario_sha256": sha256(scenario_script), "repository": EXPECTED_REPOSITORY,
        "repository_path": EXPECTED_REPO_PATH, "source_digest": EXPECTED_SOURCE_DIGEST,
        "input_manifest_sha256": EXPECTED_INPUT_MANIFEST_SHA256, "profile": EXPECTED_PROFILE,
        "request_scope": "one cache-off full-profile late-relations snapshot; no ON arm, repeats, ratios, or admission",
        "relations_cpu_profile_start_after_ns": RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_REQUESTED_START_AFTER_NS})
    save(output / "budget.json", {"batch_id": batch["batch_id"], "batch_manifest": str(Path(batch_manifest).resolve()),
        "batch_manifest_sha256": batch["manifest_sha256"], "cell_id": cell["cell_id"],
        "phase": "arm:false", "worker": batch_worker, "claim_path": str(claim_path), "identity": budget_identity})
    environment = runtime_environment(corpus_root)
    environment.update(ENTIRE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION_CORPUS_MANIFEST=str(manifest_path),
                       ENTIRE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION_CORPUS_OUTPUT=str(output / "observation.ndjson"),
                       ENTIRE_GRAPH_EXTRACTION_CORPUS_OUTPUT_FORMAT="ndjson")
    expected_control = {
        "binary_sha256": binary_sha256,
        "scenario_sha256": scenario_sha256,
        "build_manifest_sha256": sha256(build_manifest),
        "batch_manifest_sha256": sha256(batch_manifest),
        "runner_sha256": sha256(CONTROL_ROOT / "run_remote.py"),
        "budget_sha256": sha256(CONTROL_ROOT / "batch_budget.py"),
        "gate_sha256": sha256(CONTROL_ROOT / "campaign_gate.py"),
    }
    issue, before, process, artifact_counts = None, None, None, None
    profile_metadata = None
    started = False
    try:
        before = fingerprint_fn(output, scenario_script, corpus_root, "before")
        ledger.start(cell["cell_id"], "arm:false")
        started = True
        process = run_process(output, binary, environment, process_factory)
        if sha256(binary) != binary_sha256 or sha256(scenario_script) != scenario_sha256:
            raise RuntimeError("source or binary identity changed after request")
        observation_path, diagnostics_path = output / "observation.ndjson", output / "diagnostics.json"
        observation, _ = read_json_object_with_raw(observation_path)
        diagnostics, diagnostics_raw = read_json_object_with_raw(diagnostics_path)
        validate_observation(observation, manifest, binary_sha256)
        artifact_counts = validate_diagnostics(diagnostics, observation, observation_path, manifest, binary_sha256, diagnostics_raw)
        if observation["status"] == "error":
            raise RuntimeError("observation reported an explicit request error")
        if observation["status"] == "partial":
            raise RuntimeError("observation returned a provider partial; completion diagnostic stops on first issue")
        profile_metadata = validate_cpu_profile_artifacts(output, require_complete=True)
        after = fingerprint_fn(output, scenario_script, corpus_root, "after")
        if after != before:
            raise RuntimeError("input fingerprint changed during request")
    except Exception as error:
        issue = str(error)
    finally:
        if before is not None and not (output / "after.json").exists():
            try:
                after = fingerprint_fn(output, scenario_script, corpus_root, "after")
                if after != before:
                    issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + "input fingerprint changed during request"
            except Exception as error:
                issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + str(error)
        if profile_metadata is None:
            try:
                profile_metadata = validate_cpu_profile_artifacts(output, require_complete=issue is None)
                if profile_metadata.get("validation") != "complete":
                    issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + "relations CPU profile was not complete"
            except Exception as error:
                issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + str(error)
                profile_metadata = {
                    "profile": RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_NAME,
                    "status_file": RELATIONS_CPU_PROFILE_STATUS_NAME,
                    "validation": "error", "error": str(error),
                    "profile_present": False,
                    "status_present": False,
                }
        try:
            identity = post_request_identity(output, binary, scenario_script, source_root,
                                             build_manifest, batch_manifest, expected_control)
            if identity["mismatches"] or identity["errors"]:
                drift = ", ".join(identity["mismatches"] + identity["errors"])
                issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + "post-request identity check failed: " + drift
        except Exception as error:
            issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + f"post-request identity recording failed: {error}"
        if started:
            try:
                ledger.finish(cell["cell_id"], "arm:false", "ok" if issue is None else "error")
            except Exception as error:
                issue = (issue + "; " if issue else "") + f"budget ledger finish failed: {error}"
        if issue is not None:
            save(output / "outcome.json", {"status": "issue", "issue": issue, "admission_eligible": False,
                "review_status": "not_reviewed", "no_performance_claim": True,
                "process": process, "profile": profile_metadata,
                "artifact_sha256": existing_artifact_hashes(output)})
    if issue is not None:
        return {"status": "issue", "issue": issue}
    observation, _ = read_json_object_with_raw(output / "observation.ndjson")
    save(output / "outcome.json", {"status": "captured_unreviewed", "coverage": observation["status"],
        "admission_eligible": False, "review_status": "not_reviewed", "no_performance_claim": True,
        "process": process, "diagnostics": artifact_counts, "profile": profile_metadata,
        "artifact_sha256": existing_artifact_hashes(output)})

def _read_handle(document: dict) -> dict:
    handle = _load_json(HANDLE_PATH, "completion runtime handle")
    expected = {
        "dispatch_id": document["dispatch_id"],
        "unit": document["systemd_service"]["unit"],
        "remote_output_root": document["remote_output_root"],
        "source_commit": document["source_commit"],
        "binary_sha256": document["binary_sha256"],
        "batch_manifest_sha256": document["batch_manifest_sha256"],
        "control_archive_sha256": document["control_archive_sha256"],
        "controller_lease": _controller_lease(document),
    }
    for key, value in expected.items():
        if handle.get(key) != value:
            raise RuntimeError(f"completion runtime handle mismatch: {key}")
    return handle


def _status_from_response(response: str, document: dict) -> dict:
    begin, end = "COMPLETION_STATUS_JSON_BEGIN", "COMPLETION_STATUS_JSON_END"
    if response.count(begin) != 1 or response.count(end) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("completion observation has no unique status payload")
    payload = response.split(begin, 1)[1].split(end, 1)[0].strip()
    try:
        value = json.loads(payload)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
        raise RuntimeError("completion observation status is not JSON") from error
    return _validate_status(value, document)


def _validate_status(value: dict, document: dict) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("schema") != "completion-observation-v1":
        raise RuntimeError("completion observation status has the wrong schema")
    lease = _controller_lease(document)
    expected = {
        "unit": lease["unit"],
        "dispatch_id": lease["dispatch_id"],
        "controller_owner_id": lease["owner_id"],
    }
    for key, wanted in expected.items():
        if value.get(key) != wanted:
            raise RuntimeError(f"completion observation ownership mismatch: {key}")
    return value


def _collect_results(cloud, env, result_blob: str, handle: dict) -> None:
    archive_path = PREP / "results.tar.gz"
    state = handle.get("state")
    collection_error = None
    try:
        if state not in {"terminal_archive_downloaded", "terminal_artifacts_collected",
                         "terminal_resources_deallocated"}:
            cloud.download(result_blob, archive_path, env)
            handle["state"] = "terminal_archive_downloaded"
            _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
            state = "terminal_archive_downloaded"
        if state == "terminal_archive_downloaded":
            _extract_results(archive_path, PREP / "raw")
            handle["state"] = "terminal_artifacts_collected"
            _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
            state = "terminal_artifacts_collected"
    except Exception as error:
        collection_error = error
    cleanup_error = None
    if state != "terminal_resources_deallocated":
        try:
            _deallocate_all(cloud, env)
        except Exception as error:
            cleanup_error = error
    if collection_error is not None:
        if cleanup_error is not None:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"terminal artifact collection failed: {collection_error}; owned VM cleanup also failed: {cleanup_error}"
            ) from collection_error
        raise collection_error
    if cleanup_error is not None:
        raise cleanup_error
    if state != "terminal_resources_deallocated":
        handle["state"] = "terminal_resources_deallocated"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)


def _extract_results(archive_path: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
    if destination.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("completion result extraction directory already exists")
    with tarfile.open(archive_path, "r:gz") as archive:
        members = archive.getmembers()
        names = [member.name for member in members]
        if len(names) != len(set(names)):
            raise RuntimeError("completion result archive has duplicate members")
        for member in members:
            name = Path(member.name)
            if name.is_absolute() or ".." in name.parts or member.issym() or member.islnk():
                raise RuntimeError("completion result archive has unsafe members")
        temporary = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=destination.name + ".pending-", dir=destination.parent))
        try:
            archive.extractall(temporary, filter="data")
            os.replace(temporary, destination)
        except Exception as error:
            raise RuntimeError(f"completion result extraction failed; partial files retained at {temporary}") from error


def execute(cloud_module=None) -> dict:
    document = read_manifest()
    cloud = cloud_module or load_cloud_transport()
    env = cloud.environment()
    all_vms = configured_vms()
    validation_vm = all_vms[0]
    states = cloud.states(env)
    if set(states) != set(all_vms) or any(value != "VM deallocated" for value in states.values()):
        raise RuntimeError("completion diagnostic requires all three VMs initially deallocated")
    _create_dispatch_claim(document)
    handle = {
        "schema": "completion-runtime-handle-v1",
        "dispatch_id": document["dispatch_id"],
        "unit": document["systemd_service"]["unit"],
        "remote_output_root": document["remote_output_root"],
        "source_commit": document["source_commit"],
        "binary_sha256": document["binary_sha256"],
        "batch_manifest_sha256": document["batch_manifest_sha256"],
        "control_archive_sha256": document["control_archive_sha256"],
        "state": "claimed",
        "product_deadline_seconds": None,
        "retry_permitted": False,
        "controller_lease": _controller_lease(document),
    }
    _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
    remote_start_maybe = False
    try:
        cloud.start(validation_vm, env)
        handle["state"] = "vm_started"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        control_blob = document["dispatch_id"] + "-control.tar.gz"
        cloud.upload(prepared_member(document["control_archive"]), control_blob, env)
        handle["state"] = "start_call_issued"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        remote_start_maybe = True
        response = cloud.run(
            validation_vm,
            remote_start_script(document, cloud.url(control_blob, "r", env)),
        )
        (PREP / "start-transport.json").write_text(response + "\n")
        acknowledgement = "COMPLETION_DIAGNOSTIC_START_ACK:" + document["systemd_service"]["unit"]
        if acknowledgement not in response:
            handle["state"] = "start_unknown"
            _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
            raise RuntimeError("completion service start acknowledgement missing; observe exact handle and never replay")
        handle["state"] = "start_acknowledged"
        _write_json(HANDLE_PATH, handle)
        return handle
    except Exception:
        if not remote_start_maybe:
            _deallocate_all(cloud, env)
        raise


def observe(cloud_module=None) -> dict:
    document = read_manifest(require_unclaimed=False)
    if not CLAIM_PATH.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("completion dispatch claim is missing; observation cannot start work")
    handle = _read_handle(document)
    cloud = cloud_module or load_cloud_transport()
    env = cloud.environment()
